apps.name: Setsu
apps.subtitle: Personal finance tracker
apps.localizedDescription: Track budgets, expenses, goals and debts. Everything stays on your iPhone, with backups you can export and restore.

versions.localizedDescription: Backup import works again: after you pick a backup file, the confirmation now appears instead of being lost, and it is a standard alert with Cancel and Replace.
The balance card is now a Liquid Glass card stack: your other budgets peek out behind it, and tapping sends the front card to the back.
iOS 26 design with the Liquid Glass tab bar, backup export and restore in Settings, the bamboo app icon, and Analytics and Calendar as native lists.
First release of Setsu for iPhone.
